text:
alex: Heads-up — master is red after the poetry lock bump from #3425. CI failing on mac wheels only. Anyone on call who can take a look?
riley: saw that in my feed, assigning to @sam since they touched the lock change. :slightly_frowning_face:
ci-bot: build 4920 failed on macos-latest (x86_64, macos-11) — wheel build error: 'unsupported wheel tag' — logs: https://ci.internal/4920/logs
sam: I'm looking. Quick skim shows pip failing to build cryptorocks-sql 1.4.0 wheel on mac, falling back to sdist which errors due to missing libpq headers in CI image. That didn't happen on linux nodes.
alex: could this be a transitive pin from the poetry update? Which package bumped cryptorocks?
riley: lockfile diff shows cryptorocks pulled in by db-utils 0.9.2 -> db-core 2.1.0 upgrade. db-core pinned cryptorocks to 1.4.0 now.
maria: I can try a rerun on a fresh mac runner to repro locally. If it's just missing system deps we should fix the CI image.
sam: before we change images, can we bisect which dep introduced the wheel? Quick approach: revert the lock changes locally and regenerate to see when wheel started failing. That said, someone on linux already reproduced by installing from wheel and it worked.
dev-tools: FYI the mac runner base image was updated two weeks ago (openssl and homebrew changes). Could be an interplay.
alex: ok steps — (1) @sam bisect lock to identify offending transitive dep (2) @maria repro on mac runner and paste failing pip log (3) if it's just missing system headers, file an eng-infra PR to add pkg to the image.
sam: starting bisect now. command I'm running: ```git checkout master && git checkout -b lock-bisect && git revert --no-commit <lock-commit> && poetry lock --no-update && tox -e py39 -- tests/test_db.py::test_connection``` I'll iterate commits from the lock bump PR.
maria: reproing in a disposable mac VM, getting error: ```error: pg_config executable not found. Please add PostgreSQL to PATH or install libpq-dev``` — that seems consistent with missing client libs.
alex: if cryptorocks wheels used to include prebuilt binaries on macos and now it's sdist then pg_config needed. Maybe wheel name now uses a tag not supported by our builder so pip falls back. Sam any luck with the bisect?
sam: bisect done — culprit is db-core@2.1.0 which pins cryptorocks 1.4.0. earlier db-core@2.0.5 used cryptorocks 1.3.8 wheel that installed fine. So the lock bump indirectly brought in 1.4.0.
riley: granting quick mitigation: pin cryptorocks==1.3.8 in pyproject's [tool.poetry.dependencies] and regenerate lock to stop CI failing while we decide long-term fix. Thoughts?
maria: that will restore CI quickly. We should also open an issue upstream about cryptorocks wheels for mac or add pg_config in image.
alex: agree. @sam please PR a temporary pin + changelog entry, and @dev-tools please start a ticket to add libpq/pg_config to mac CI images.
sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/pulls/678 (poetry: pin cryptorocks to 1.3.8, regen lock). CI rerun queued.
ci-bot: build 4922 queued.
ci-bot: build 4922 passed on macos-latest. :tada:
riley: awesome, thanks team. We'll track long-term in infra backlog.
alex: closing the incident for now — follow-ups: infra ticket, upstream wheel issue, and a postmortem note in #postmortems. :white_check_mark:
